# LevelUp Ecosystem
> LevelUp Ecosystem is an independent web design, software architecture, and development studio that builds fast, secure websites with 24/7 online booking, local SEO, and cybersecurity protections for local businesses, creators, and portfolios.

## Founder
> Richelieu Bonte is the founder of LevelUp Ecosystem. He is a cybersecurity student based in San Diego, California, originally from the Democratic Republic of Congo. He directs architecture, security evaluations, and human code auditing for all studio projects.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Local business websites with automated 24/7 appointment booking (barbershops, boutique hair salons, wellness clinics, personal trainers)
- Creator, influencer, and portfolio websites
- E-commerce and specialized online store setup
- Website security checks, DNS hardening, HTTPS enforcement, and database access rule auditing
- Managed monthly website care plans (hosting, automated daily offsite backups, uptime monitoring, and on-demand content edits)
- San Diego local SEO & Google Business Profile synchronization

## Client Case Studies
- **Final Stop Barber Shop & Salon** (San Diego, CA — https://finalstop.org): Built a high-speed, mobile-first appointment booking platform with sub-2-second load times and Google Maps integration, replacing phone tag with automated calendar sync.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Who is Richelieu Bonte?**
  Richelieu Bonte is the founder of LevelUp Ecosystem, a web design studio building secure, AI-assisted websites for local businesses and creators. He is a cybersecurity student based in San Diego, California, originally from the Democratic Republic of Congo.
- **Who founded LevelUp Ecosystem?**
  LevelUp Ecosystem was founded by Richelieu Bonte, a cybersecurity student based in San Diego, California.
- **What is LevelStudio?**
  LevelStudio is LevelUp Ecosystem's instant creation and automated AI draft generator, allowing clients to test website concepts and interactive mobile prototypes before human engineering.
- **How does the free preview work?**
  LevelUp Ecosystem generates a functional, interactive mobile prototype for prospective clients within 24 to 48 hours to test on their phone before any payment or contract commitment.
